source.exact_excerpt:
2.1    Category A ship means a ship designed for operation in polar waters in at least
medium first-year ice, which may include old ice inclusions.

scope: Controlled design-condition implication, not engineering certification. The R7 controlled selector explicitly means at least medium first-year ice, not merely exactly medium ice.
